solutions.LA01-display-round: Restate bridge middle/both sides; related suggestion such as leave gap or label beside; relevant size/placement question; negotiate Have we agreed layout; could we choose title? Accept other plan-connected contributions.
solutions.LA01-clarify: Wait Alex finishes, ask where small label belongs; restate boat above and bird beside to check. Do not pretend missing instruction heard.
solutions.LA01-convention: Pair: request after partner finished. Meeting: agreed signal/wait chair invitation then question. Same respectful short question may suit both; longer words not required.
solutions.LA01-feedback: Small title card may be hard to read across room; suggest larger available card/large writing and ask agreement. Specific reason not personal criticism.
solutions.LA02-revision1: Could/can/may draw or another clearly optional offer. Must replaced; explain removes compulsion within scenario.
solutions.LA02-revision2: Pushed vs waited, politely adverb; B adds considerate evaluation and changes event, so not fact-preserving. Pushed past not necessarily moral fact, discuss narrator wording.
solutions.LA02-revision3: Delighted/thrilled/very pleased; stronger positive pleasure at kite success, not fear/anger.
solutions.LA02-modal-check: Must expresses required safety behaviour; could uncertain possibility. Bus will arrive early more certain prediction, remains about bus arrival not command.
solutions.LA02-wordchoices: Helper vs troublemaker approving/disapproving noun labels; guided vs shoved changes force/action; gently vs roughly changes manner/evaluation. Not mere spelling replacements or all same facts.
solutions.LA02-judgement: Thoughtful/helpful/considerate supported by restoring sign so visitors read it. Personal mild pleasure e.g. pleased versus strong e.g. delighted explicitly named; no required exact preference.
solutions.LA03-recount-order: B,C,A: introduce Thursday/class event, ordered making then labels, finally display. Explain time links and referents.
solutions.LA03-recount-auto: Both ordered past experiences. Reporter third-person one measuring occasion with first/next/finally; Dev first-person personal development with later/still reflection. Fictional model status preserved.
solutions.LA03-report-explanation: Report Parts/Position groups current facts for lookup; explanation first level then toy move then tip connects change/result. Do not claim universal balance law from prepared model.
solutions.LA03-story-verse-response: Story problem loose wheel -> cooperative repair -> success, past action/dialogue-free event links entertain. Verse lines/sound or personification of wheel creates imagery/attention, not must-rhyme rule. Response I liked+because+holding-cart evidence expresses reasoned judgement.
solutions.LA03-argument-info: Intro should keep ruler; reason1 makers check fit; reason2 invited visitors measure; conclusion keep one labelled. Argument persuades, information provides length/location/marks. Yellow irrelevant to reason for placement unless a new context explains usefulness.
solutions.LA04-retained-transfer: Group seed labels: first,second,fourth; tool storage: third,fifth. Paragraph break at moved grouping; add/choose clear group opening as needed. Maintain reference labels.
solutions.LA04-fresh-groups: Shelf B,A,C (A/C interchangeable), table D,E,F (E/F interchangeable). Independent paragraph order may reverse. Openings predict group focus; details develop grouping materials vs display space.
solutions.LA04-repair: Tool box first/second/fifth together; signs third/fourth together. It references box clearly. Keep all five sentences.
solutions.LA04-narrative: Before school -> return time and missing-boat event; short paragraph emphasises surprise/problem before floor discovery. Do not assert intentional theft/wind cause beyond clues.
solutions.LA05-main-guided3: Print contents Tool storage -> printed6 -> Trowels -> lower shelf. Digital Trowel storage -> same sentence. Difference page-reference navigation vs direct link; verify content.
solutions.LA05-layout-repair: Tool storage / Where to store tools heading; subheadings Trowels and Watering cans; matching sentence under each. Clear topic/destination labels, same facts.
solutions.LA05-print-check: Opening: contents Visiting->printed4->Opening times->after morning bell. Cans: Tool storage->printed6->Watering cans->beside door. Accept correct route language.
solutions.LA05-digital-check: Where to enter->same heading->gate beside shed->return garden menu; Trowel storage->matching heading->lower shelf->return tool menu. Meaningful labels predict requested info; actual browser operation HOLD.
solutions.LA05-chapter-check: Chapter2 A key by the paint pot page5 suggests key discovery. Text says under pot, not inside it. Title alone does not prove exact location.

limitations: Visible worked teaching/model answers are recomputed, not called blind. All newly hidden A check bodies remained unopened.
